enemies.role: Quick single shots at mid range, moving between cover. Light infantry.
enemies.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE concept sheet for an original pistol infantry enemy for BattleDuty-aimbot. Input rifle and SMG images are approved family STYLE references only. Match exactly their normal adult human proportions, broad visibly triangular polygonal geometry in cloth and armor, charcoal/slate gray matte palette, faceted boots/gloves, restrained texture and brick-red shoulder identity panels. Create a lightly armored adult male pistol trooper: compact faceted helmet, exposed human face, light short plate vest, two small pistol-magazine belt pouches instead of rifle chest pouches, simple utility belt, modest elbow/knee protection, practical slate uniform. Small original variations, same family and detail density. No weapon, holstered gun, or hand prop: approved family bodies have empty hands and guns are separate runtime attachments. Plain light-gray studio background, soft cool even light. TWO full-body views of this SAME design, left strict front and right three-quarter front, equal scale and feet baseline, neutral symmetrical A-pose arms about 45 degrees away from torso, straight elbows, open separated fingers, feet slightly apart. Entire hands and boots visible, ample margins and space between views. Clear armpits, crotch and separated limbs for image-to-3D and Mixamo. No labels, logos, watermarks, scenery, robot parts, sci-fi lights, excessive gear or photoreal smooth clothing.
enemies.props: None; approved family bodies use separate runtime weapons.

enemies.role: Near-invisible stalking followed by unarmed melee strike. No weapon baked into concept.
enemies.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE concept sheet for an original unarmed cloaker melee ambusher for BattleDuty-aimbot. Approved rifle and SMG images are family STYLE references; match their human adult proportions, visibly broad triangular polygon facets in cloth and armor, matte charcoal/slate-gray palette, boots, gloves, restrained wear and detail density exactly. Original agile lean adult human operative with close-fitting faceted charcoal balaclava exposing believable human eyes, slim slate uniform, compact low-profile chest protection, simple utility belt WITHOUT ammunition pouches, practical reinforced faceted forearm guards and knuckle gloves for empty-handed strikes, low-profile knee protection and same family lace-up combat boots. Small muted brick-red shoulder identification tabs. No gun, knife, baton, sword, holster, ammunition, shield, cape or backpack: this enemy is UNARMED and strikes in MELEE, cloaks then ambushes. Show fully opaque body for modeling; no invisibility effects. Light gray plain background, soft cool even studio light. TWO full-body views of SAME character: left strict front and right front three-quarter, equal scale, same feet baseline, symmetrical A-pose arms 45 degrees clear from body, open hands with separated fingers, straight riggable limbs, feet slightly apart. Entire hands and feet with generous margins and gap between views. Match reference family; no robot mask, glowing optics, decorative sci-fi tech, photoreal smooth cloth, labels, logos or watermark.
